us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Fed decision looms as Treasury yields edge higher
bullets: Treasury yields ticked higher before the Federal Reserve decision.
Traders awaited the central bank’s latest policy statement.
The decision followed a busy earnings and inflation week.

articles.title: US consumer confidence improves as gas prices ease
bullets: Consumer confidence rebounded in October, AP reported.
Gas prices fell modestly from recent highs.
Inflation remained a major pressure for households.

articles.title: Mortgage rates fall again, but borrowers seek riskier loans
bullets: Mortgage rates declined for a second straight week.
Borrower demand rose only slightly, CNBC reported.
More borrowers sought savings through riskier loan products.

articles.title: Musk PAC lawyer runs in Texas district tied to billionaire’s businesses
bullets: Chris Gober is the GOP nominee in Texas’s 10th District.
The district includes major Tesla and SpaceX interests.
CNBC reported on the race and business connections.

articles.title: Atlanta Dream criticizes WNBA Finals lunchtime schedule
bullets: Atlanta Dream criticized a Thursday afternoon Finals game time.
The schedule drew reactions from public figures.
CNBC reported Flavor Flav and Hillary Clinton weighed in.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Spain high-speed train crash leaves 10 dead, local media say
bullets: Local media reported 10 confirmed deaths in Spain.
The crash involved a high-speed train.
CNBC carried the report Wednesday morning.

articles.title: Oil rises after Houthi attacks raise Saudi refinery concerns
bullets: Oil prices climbed Wednesday, CNBC reported.
Investors weighed supply risks from Middle East conflict.
Houthi attacks on a Saudi refinery heightened worries.

articles.title: Israel election appears headed for no clear winner
bullets: Exit polls showed no bloc near a governing majority.
Netanyahu’s alliance and Gadi Eisenkot’s bloc both fell short.
Coalition talks were expected after the vote.

articles.title: China pushes car exports as domestic showrooms weaken
bullets: CNBC reported empty or closed Chinese auto showrooms.
Autumn is traditionally a peak car-buying season.
Export markets have become increasingly important for automakers.

articles.title: Mbappé faces China backlash as sponsors cut ties
bullets: Chinese state media warned Kylian Mbappé after a viral meme controversy.
Sponsors cut ties, CNBC reported.
His apology was judged against future actions, state media said.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India-focused headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Indian investors rush into US stocks through local apps
bullets: Major Indian brokerages opened easier access to US markets.
Retail investors targeted Nvidia, SpaceX and Apple, CNBC reported.
The rollout expanded overseas investing options for millions.

articles.title: RBI likely intervenes to support rupee as oil pressures currency
bullets: Traders said India’s central bank likely intervened Wednesday.
Persistently high oil prices weighed on the rupee.
Reuters reported the intervention expectations from Mumbai traders.

articles.title: Jio Platforms shares soar after record IPO debut
bullets: Jio Platforms shares rose more than 21% on debut.
The listing followed a record IPO, CNBC reported.
Meta and Google are major backers of the company.

articles.title: Indian media debate France riots and protest coverage
bullets: Le Monde reported Indian media amplified France riot footage.
Coverage referenced India’s Gen Z protest movement.
The report examined pro-government and far-right networks.

articles.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Times of India reports
bullets: Times of India reported OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Terra launch.
The product was framed around computer-use capabilities.
The story appeared in Wednesday’s DailyHub news roundup.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Market movers and trading stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Vertiv jumps after raising full-year outlook
bullets: Vertiv rose about 16% premarket, StockTitan reported.
Third-quarter sales increased 61%.
The company raised its full-year sales forecast by $650 million.

articles.title: Enphase sinks on weak solar demand and softer forecast
bullets: Enphase fell more than 18% premarket.
The company cited soft US residential solar demand.
Fourth-quarter revenue guidance came in lower.

articles.title: Surgery Partners surges after $5.7 billion takeover proposal
bullets: Surgery Partners shares jumped nearly 48%.
HealthSpan Partners proposed a $5.7 billion takeover.
DailyHub named it the stock of the day.

articles.title: Wendy’s rises sharply without identified company news
bullets: Wendy’s rose about 15.5% premarket.
StockTitan found no company news as of 8:03 a.m. ET.
The move appeared among the day’s biggest gainers.

articles.title: Robinhood falls after results show crypto revenue slump
bullets: Robinhood fell about 6.8% premarket.
Crypto revenue dropped 55% from a year earlier.
Total revenue still reached a record, StockTitan reported.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economy stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Stellantis reports $4.5 billion cash drain amid turnaround
bullets: Stellantis reported a 4 billion euro cash shortfall.
That equals about $4.5 billion, CNBC said.
The automaker’s turnaround plan remained underway.

articles.title: UBS third-quarter pretax profit rises 27%
bullets: UBS reported pretax profit of $3.59 billion.
The result marked a 27% increase, CNBC reported.
The bank’s quarterly earnings were released Wednesday.

articles.title: Luxury round-the-world cruise ends early as fuel costs surge
bullets: Villa Vie Residences ended a luxury cruise abruptly.
The company cited soaring fuel costs.
It said passengers and crew would disembark during restructuring.

articles.title: DraftKings CEO urges parents to discuss gambling addiction
bullets: Jason Robins discussed gambling addiction with CNBC.
He said parents should talk with children about risks.
The comments referenced how he approaches the issue at home.

articles.title: Pop Mart shares extend decline after quarterly sales plunge
bullets: Pop Mart reported a sharp third-quarter revenue decline.
CNBC cited a 45% to 50% year-on-year drop.
Shares of the Labubu maker extended losses.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Technology and AI stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Nvidia to invest $3 billion in Meta partnership
bullets: Axios reported Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta.
The story led DailyHub’s Wednesday morning roundup.
The partnership expands ties between two AI leaders.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO plans could produce historic offering
bullets: Scripps News reported Anthropic plans an IPO.
DailyHub said it could be the biggest stock offering ever.
The filing boosted attention on AI-linked equities.

articles.title: Google expands cloud AI chip sales through partners
bullets: Google is changing how it sells TPUs, CNBC reported.
The company is enlisting partners to sell more AI chips.
Custom chips are becoming a bigger growth driver.

articles.title: SK Hynix profit beats estimates on AI memory demand
bullets: SK Hynix reported third-quarter earnings Wednesday.
CNBC said profit sharply beat estimates.
AI memory demand supported the chipmaker’s results.

articles.title: Apple expected to unveil touchscreen MacBook Pro models
bullets: Benzinga reported Apple was expected to unveil touchscreen MacBook Pros.
The story appeared in DailyHub’s Wednesday roundup.
The launch would expand Apple’s laptop hardware lineup.
